initialCityPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent-background game level diorama for the stage-selection screen of an existing anime science-fiction tower-defense game, Starfall Defense.
Primary request: one detailed miniature 3D isometric battlefield on a thick rectangular cutaway concrete base. A ruined futuristic urban evacuation avenue runs from the foreground up toward a fortified gate at the back; broken road markings, metal anti-vehicle barricades, sandbags, lamps, shattered elevated walkways, two damaged low buildings framing the avenue, a tiny abandoned evacuation vehicle and restrained cyan defense-light accents. No people. This is a physical miniature battlefield, clearly bounded on its own raised base, viewed from above at 40 degrees, near-symmetrical with front edge visible, visually readable at phone size.
Style: premium Japanese mobile strategy-game environment asset; crisp painterly PBR 3D, miniature architectural model, credible weathered steel and concrete, appealing detailed silhouette, not photoreal photography and not flat vector.
Lighting: moody blue-hour ambient light with soft warm amber highlights, bright enough to read the road and architecture against a dark navy UI.
Composition: square image, whole model centered, occupies about 88 percent of image, no cropping, transparent background with actual alpha, no surrounding landscape, no ground plane beyond the model base. Absolutely no UI, no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, menus, borders, or labels. No red gore.
